title: Button

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Human interface device that emits a signal

body:
"Activates an output of 10.0 for 1 second when pressed."

The Button is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs a momentary signal when it is interacted with.

Functionality

Interacting with the Button emits a signal of strength 10 for a short moment. The Button inherits the color of the wire that is attached to its output port.

Trivia

  • This item was previously called the "ButtonComponent".
